codes.label: Engagement metric
codes.definition: Paper reports DAU, MAU, session length, or return rate as a primary outcome.

codes.label: Reflection prompt
codes.definition: System asks the user to consider their feelings, behavior, or values.

codes.label: Reflection scaffold
codes.definition: System provides a structured frame (e.g., journaling template, 5-whys) to guide reflection.

codes.label: User agency
codes.definition: User controls pacing, topic, or termination of the interaction.

codes.label: System initiative
codes.definition: System initiates contact or topic shift unprompted.

codes.label: Parasocial framing
codes.definition: System uses friendship, companionship, or relational language.

codes.label: Behavioral outcome
codes.definition: Paper measures or reports change in user behavior outside the interaction.
